tagline: A booming ultra-luxury archipelago on a shallow protected bank — tailor-made for quiet electric hops.
summary: Turks & Caicos has become one of the Caribbean's fastest-growing ultra-luxury destinations, anchored by Providenciales (Grace Bay) and reaching to the quieter Caicos cays (Parrot Cay, Pine Cay, North/Middle/South Caicos) and the capital Cockburn Town on Grand Turk. The shallow, protected Caicos Bank keeps most legs calm and inside Pioneer II range, while a Quanta-LR run links Provo to Grand Turk.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II owns the intra-bank resort and private-island transfers around Providenciales (Parrot Cay, Pine Cay, North/Middle/South Caicos) — all on a calm, protected bank.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Quanta-LR (H2 2026+) adds the Provo↔Grand Turk link (~75 nm) and any reach to the southern Caicos and beyond.

competitive_landscape: Resort launches and limited inter-island air (Caicos Express, interCaribbean) serve TCI today — demand proof, not threats. There is no foiling incumbent; the bank's calm, shallow water is ideal for low-wake electric operation.
seasonality: Atlantic hurricane season (Jun–Nov) is the constraint; the protected Caicos Bank keeps most legs calm year-round, supporting a long Pioneer II window. Winter is peak.
regulatory_note: UK Overseas Territory; Turks & Caicos Ports Authority and TCI government procurement. Clean-fleet, low-wake operation aligns with the bank's protected marine environment.
key_partners: Amanyara / COMO Parrot Cay / Pine Cay
